category_title: Struggling readers who forget intended dictation during technology delays
student_description: David is a student who struggles with the dual cognitive load of remembering his ideas while operating speech recognition (SR) technology. He frequently goes blank when initiating dictation and quickly loses interest when the technology times out or transcribes incorrectly. He uniquely requires immediate verbal reminders of his ideas and direct proxy dictation by the teacher when technology barriers arise, alongside long-term modeling of SR use and brainstorming.

criteria.criterion_name: Explicit Modeling of SR Accuracy Analysis
criteria.rationale: David needs to see SR modeled and its inaccuracies discussed so he understands that technology errors are normal and can be evaluated.
criteria.check: The long-term plan includes the tutor modeling SR use and explicitly discussing the accuracy or inaccuracies of the resulting transcriptions with the student.

criteria.rationale: Because David struggles with the cognitive load of drafting and may want to skip brainstorming, he needs explicit modeling of how to brainstorm aloud and draft using SR and other tools.
criteria.check: The long-term plan incorporates the tutor brainstorming aloud and modeling the drafting process using SR alongside other writing methods.
